notes.title: Patch v.38 News
notes.content:
Hey all,

We're releasing a graphics update, which we hope will be the first phase of a series of incremental and continued visual improvements within BL Pro Surfing. It's no exaggeration to say that this patch has been a slog to re-engineer and it's also fair to suggest, it's been anything but trivial. Anyone who knows anything about water graphics in video games can vouch for that :). We broke a bunch of our systems (and nearly our sanity!) during the course of this upgrade and aside from introducing new shaders and underlying code, just putting it all back together has been a mission. We hope that it's been worth it. There is still more to do but all things being equal, now we've got the bulk of this work in place, we should be able to update in smaller increments again and that the next couple of patches [i]should[/i] be faster. 

The next immediate goals are to get back on to some of the gameplay adjustments and upgrades. We've started work on some of these gameplay additions already and we hope to continue to improve and build out the experience. We are going hard at it.

We’d like to take this opportunity thank you for your continued feedback and support. We really do appreciate it. 

Thank you,
Bungarra Software

notes.title: Online Server Outage
notes.content:
Hey all,

Unfortunately, we received an email last night from our service provider. They are the people who host our online servers and they have suffered a recent outage. As a result, our in-game player data has been lost.

This affects online leaderboard scores, times etc, only. It does not include any personal data whatsoever.

However, rest assured that we are on the case and are aiming to restore our systems, and this will take us approximately one week to accomplish.

We’d like to take this opportunity to apologize for the inconvenience, and to thank you for your understanding in this matter.

We’ve been overwhelmed with the positive reception we’ve received since we launched Barton Lynch Pro Surfing back in November last year, and we look forward to continuing to support our game to provide the best surfing experience possible to our players.

As soon as the system has been restored, we’ll be sure to make another announcement right here. So please stay tuned.

Thank you,
Bungarra Software

notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
Early Access

Hey thanks for taking an interest in BL Pro Surfing. 32 iterations later, and we are leaving Early Access today. Although its been a much longer journey than we anticipated, it has been for the better. The direct feedback we've received from you has helped make BL Pro Surfing a more solid and viable game, than when entered into EA. Without your direct input, we seriously would not have even been able to get to this point. We are genuinely grateful and humbled by the early access experience. Is there more to do? Yes. So things like adding a first person camera, or refining the Steam Deck experience. So this is not a victory lap, nor are we making [i]any[/i] bold claims. For our small team, this is just a mini milestone that has been reached and we aiming to continue to improve the experience. So we are now getting on with the business of fixing and adding more of the features that you have asked for and we're in it for the long haul. Surfing is a really hard game to build.

So nothing changes and its business as usual. We'll be fixing, and updating and adding more content as we have done since our very first day one of EA.

notes.title: Early Access Release v.024
notes.content:
This update focuses on bug fixes, feedback and further tightening up the gameplay as we work on both the PC and the console builds.

v.024 is a large update as there is a major restructure of the Online Leaderboard Legends underway. In short, we are implementing an accurate asynchronous multiplayer ghost system to allow for people to see their friends ghost and compete directly against that ghost and recorded on a leaderboard. This includes a messaging and monetary reward system for people challenging your score.

This is a leap from what we had originally planned to deliver for this mode and will provide a more fun experience. There is a fair way to go and the tables are fairly empty at the moment but progress is being made. You can currently challenge a couple of the test scores, but not all of them. It is playable but please be aware that there are bugs as this is a major re-structure.

In the interim we've also added some new animations that people have asked for (along with scores), and with some fairly extensive localisation fixes - including the ability to save games in a specific language which has been a problem.

notes.title: Roadmap Update - Barton Lynch Pro Surfing
notes.content:
Hey, thanks for being here and showing an interest in Barton Lynch Pro Surfing. This game is made by a small group of people (2 FTE, 6 PTE), passionate about the sport of surfing, our lifestyle and our culture. 

We initially wanted to be at release around 3 months after Early Access. Since then our team has taken on your feedback as we continue to work hard to fix bugs and bed down the games infrastructure. notes.title: Early Access Release v.016

Good evening,

With yesterday's release of v.015, we unintentionally changed the location of the save files. This will cause the game to believe that there are no save files if you've played before the update. With this small patch, we aim to correct the issue.

If you want to recover your save from before v.015, all you need to do is download the new update and the saves will reappear when you boot up Barton Lynch Pro Surfing 2022.

If you've played the game since the update and would prefer to keep the new save, you can simply copy and paste the PlayerInfo.sav file over to the original save folder.

Save file path before v.015 (the folder with your original save):
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Bungarra Software/Barton Lynch Surfing 2022/PlayerSave/

Save file path from v.015 (the folder with the new save):
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Bungarra Software Pty Ltd/Barton Lynch Surfing 2022/PlayerSave/

If you haven't accessed the AppData folder on your computer before, here's a guide:
https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/appdata-where-to-find-the-appdata-folder-in-windows-10/

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey, thanks for being here and showing an interest in Barton Lynch Pro Surfing. This game is made by a small group of people (around 4 FTE, 4 PTE), passionate about surfing - this includes the sport, the lifestyle and our culture. We're still working on the game and we are constantly fixing bugs and adding new features. 

This roadmap is a basic plan for where we are now, and where we plan to take this. It’s a full game, but we’re still working on it and we’ve got a lot of plans. Some features that didn’t make the initial cut are in the process of being polished and will be added in future updates. 

Right now our focus is on taking on board the communities feedback, fixing bugs and optimizing and as we get further along we can begin to add more features.
